biography: Kiko Porto, a name synonymous with Brazilian flair on the racetrack, didn't come from racing pedigree. Born in the favelas of Rio de Janeiro, his early life was a far cry from the roaring engines he now commands. He found his calling watching Ayrton Senna on a grainy TV, dreaming of speed and glory. His entry into motorsports was unconventional – street racing, honing his skills dodging traffic and outmaneuvering rivals. A local businessman, impressed by his raw talent, sponsored him in karting, where he quickly dominated. From there, his rise was meteoric, catching the eye of Lamborghini, where he's been a stalwart ever since. Now, at 38, Porto is a veteran, his experience a valuable asset to the team, though the younger generation is nipping at his heels, desperate to claim his spot. He's hoping for one last title run to cement his legacy.
drivingStyle: Porto is known for his aggressive, flamboyant style. He attacks corners with a ferocity that often leaves rivals scrambling, relying on instinct and car control honed on the unforgiving streets of Rio. While some criticize his tire management, particularly in longer races, his raw speed is undeniable. Under pressure, he thrives, often pulling off daring overtakes in the closing laps. He’s a showman, always looking for the spectacular maneuver, even if it comes at a risk.

rivalries.name: Alessandro Rossi
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at Monza in 2018, where Porto accused Rossi of intentionally blocking him.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle for the lead in the 24 Hours of Daytona, characterized by aggressive defending and a near-miss incident in the final hour.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A clash of generations, with Tanaka representing the new wave of meticulously trained drivers, contrasting sharply with Porto's raw, instinctual style.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky charm – a small, worn leather bracelet given to him by his grandmother.
Listens to a specific samba song before every race to calm his nerves and connect with his roots.
Refuses to start a race if he sees a black cat crossing his path.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about heart. You have to feel the car, feel the track, feel the rhythm of the race. If you don't have heart, you're just driving a machine."
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2015, piloting the Lamborghini to a dramatic victory after a rain-soaked final stint, cementing his place as a top endurance racer.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the Brazilian Grand Prix in 2019, in front of his home crowd, due to a mechanical failure that sent him spinning into the wall.
